We make ineligible for the FYF certain content that may not be appropriate for a broad audience related to: (1) Behavioral Health, (2) Sensitive and Mature Themes, (3) Integrity and Authenticity, and (4) Regulated Goods. Content that is ineligible for the FYF can still be discovered in other ways, such as through search tools or by following an account.We proactively enforce our Community Guidelines through a mix of technology and human moderation. We have detected this policy violation using automated measures. We have used automated measures in making this decision.
